items.title: PMax Transition
items.note:
Salam,

  • Google confirmed QHVAC's LSA account is transitioning to Performance Max with pay per lead bidding, expected to begin around August 1. Google's own notification timing has been inconsistent, so treat this as imminent rather than waiting for an official cutover notice.
  • Download and save all historical LSA performance data immediately. None of it carries over automatically once the account transitions, and it's the only record of what's actually been working.
  • Upload a customer match list to Google Ads Audience Manager. This is the main lever for keeping targeting quality up under PMax's less transparent bidding.
  • Prepare a budget reallocation plan between Search or PMax and the legacy LSA campaign as a hedge, in case lead quality or volume dips during the switch.
  • Samudh (Google) is sending a recap email and scheduling a follow up call for next week (Mon or Tue) with Sohib. Hold that call before making the reallocation final.

Assigned to: Ads Team, Khurram Jamil
